chapters.name: The world, year by year
chapters.describe: City lights across the planet from 2012 to 2023. As the glow grows, the pad swells and brightens. The video decides how far the music will brighten, I chose the sounds it would open to.

chapters.name: What changed
chapters.describe: Purple marks new light since 2012, orange is the light lost. When the screen shows more purple than orange, when the world grew brighter is when the chords switch to a brighter version I wrote for this mix.

chapters.name: Four regions
chapters.describe: The beat comes in here. Western Europe, the Eastern Mediterranean, Ukraine and India each have their own instrument, as loud as the region's own lights.

chapters.name: Gained and lost
chapters.describe: India gained the most light and its melody comes through strongest, and Ukraine and Western Europe lost light so we have the drums fall silent for them.
